{{Top}}
A '''personality matrix''', also known as a '''personality module''',<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> was a component of a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that dictated its personality and behavior and, by that extension, gave it individuality. It's possible that a droid's [[sentience programming]] [[Metaprogramming|affected]] this component.
